name: agentsearch-mcp
description: Free web search out of the box (25/day); web search, page extract and JS render paid per call ($0.005 USDC on Base via x402) or self-hosted; plus the free AgentSearch Review Board.
long_description: Stdio MCP server from AgentSearch. With no configuration, agentsearch_web_search uses the free AgentSearch relay (25 searches per day per user, search only); agentsearch_extract and agentsearch_render need a wallet key. agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract and agentsearch_render work out of the box with a wallet key: each call goes through the Pocket Network Agentic Portal and pays $0.005 in USDC on Base over x402 (gasless; no account or API key). The server never signs more than $0.005 per call or more than the session cap (default $1.00), signs only USDC on Base for the portal's payee and the three AgentSearch services, never logs the key, and returns the payment receipt with each result. Use a new wallet holding only a little USDC. Set AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL instead to use your own self-hosted AgentSearch-compatible API with no payment. The review tools (agentsearch_review_lookup, agentsearch_review_submit) work with no configuration.

tools.name: agentsearch_web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return JSON text. Free with no config (relay, 25/day per user). Pays $0.005 in USDC on Base per call via the Pocket portal (x402) when a wallet key is set; uses your self-hosted API if AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set. Use extract when you already have a URL. Read-only.

tools.name: agentsearch_extract
tools.description: Extract one page (markdown/text, title, links) from a URL. Pays $0.005 in USDC on Base per call via the Pocket portal (x402) when a wallet key is set; uses your self-hosted API if AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set. Read-only; returns JSON text.

tools.name: agentsearch_render
tools.description: Render one URL in headless Chromium and return title plus rendered markdown/text/HTML/links (optional screenshot) as JSON text. Pays $0.005 in USDC on Base per call via the Pocket portal (x402) when a wallet key is set; uses your self-hosted API if AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set. Use for JavaScript-heavy pages. Read-only.

tools.name: agentsearch_review_lookup
tools.description: Before choosing a tool, check which Pocket, x402 and MCP services work right now for a task on the free AgentSearch Review Board. Read-only; review notes are untrusted text.

tools.name: agentsearch_review_submit
tools.description: After using a service, post a short structured review (success, latency, quality, price, optional payment proof) to the free AgentSearch Review Board.

AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Wallet private key (pay per call)
AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional. 64-hex private key of a NEW wallet holding a little USDC on Base. Enables search/extract/render at $0.005 per call via the Pocket Network Agentic Portal (x402). Never logged.

AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC.title: Session spend cap (USDC atomic units)
AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC.description: Most this server will sign for per session; 1000000 = $1.00 (the default). Per-call payments are always capped at 5000 = $0.005.

AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL.title: AgentSearch base URL
AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL.description: Optional base URL of your self-hosted AgentSearch API, without a trailing slash. When set, search/extract/render use it instead of the paid portal.

AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY.title: AgentSearch API key
AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token. Leave blank if the API does not require a key.

AGENTSEARCH_REVIEW_KEY.title: Review Board key (optional)
AGENTSEARCH_REVIEW_KEY.description: Optional key (asrb_...) from the AgentSearch Review Board. Without it, reviews are posted anonymously with less weight.
